## Checklist

- [ ] `node --test scripts/test/` passes (run inside the skill folder)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` and `references/` match the code (flags, exit codes, config fields)
- [ ] `description` is third person, says what and when, at most 1024 characters
- [ ] Nothing the skill needs lives outside its folder
- [ ] No secrets, private paths or real names
- [ ] `evals/` updated if the trigger words changed
